notes: REF-BM-02: no metadata fetch at all (title entered manually; no description/favicon/preview). REF-BM-03: title editable before/after save, but nothing is auto-collected and no description field exists. REF-BM-04: edits url/title/tags/notes only; no separate description field. REF-BM-06: duplicate URL is detected and a warning shown but a new bookmark is still created ('saved anyway') — does not converge to editing the existing one. REF-BM-07: list shows title/url/notes/tags but no favicon and no description. REF-BM-10: tag input is free-text comma list with autocomplete=off; no existing-tag suggestions. REF-BM-12: searches title/url/notes/tags (description field absent). REF-BM-14: '#tag' has no special handling, treated as literal LIKE. REF-BM-15/16: no boolean/parenthesis operators or quoted-phrase parsing. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, unread view, or read toggle. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list is fixed-ordered by date_added DESC with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: notes stored/displayed as plain text (textContent), not rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive concept. REF-BM-29: no bundles. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings.
